name: PR Overview shows the Brief card, and a review-focus entry jumps to that file in the diff
description: A7/A8's browser lane. From PR #482's Overview tab, confirm the Brief card renders what was generated: the risk level, what and why, a risk pill that expands to its explanation and grounded file refs, and the ordered Read these first list. Then click a review-focus entry and confirm it lands on the diff with that file expanded. The brief is SEEDED, not generated here: generation is the one step of this feature that costs a model call, and no flow may make one — same reasoning as 11-pr-intent. Regenerate is deliberately never clicked. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
